author: mooncat69
body: OK, someone is in Nebula, they are playing and then suddenly you break a rule that they only did one time and get temp-banned for it no second chance. I will be standing up for them the next time a staff member does that because they nee a second chance so if they have their warning, they will often won't do it again. if your child goes on the computer for too long, you'll ground them just like that decision is final? If some pre-school kids were misbehaving, you would punish them? I don't believe in no second chances, I would just kick them even if they were hacking; so can you please give players a second chance? It's called courage.
